# Settings

<!-- Generated by `clear-ls settings-doc` from `src/clear_ls/lsp/settings.cr`; edit there. -->

Pass them as `initializationOptions` when the client starts the server, or
send them later with `workspace/didChangeConfiguration` (`{"settings": {"clearLs": {...}}}`).
Nested objects: `compiler.enabled` is `{"compiler": {"enabled": ...}}`. Unknown keys
and wrong types are logged and ignored. Settings marked *restart* are read once, at startup.

## `compiler`

| Key | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `compiler.enabled` | bool | `true` | Background `crystal build --no-codegen` checks (diagnostics, compiler facts). Formatting and macro expansion use the compiler regardless. *restart* |
| `compiler.path` | string | — | The `crystal` executable (default `$CRYSTAL`, else `crystal` on `PATH`). *restart* |
| `compiler.entries` | string array | — | Programs to check, relative to the root, instead of the `shard.yml` targets. *restart* |
| `compiler.debounceMs` | int | `150` | Delay before a check after a save, in milliseconds. *restart* |
| `compiler.facts` | bool | `true` | Add the facts exporter to each check: methods generated by macros and ivar types from the compiler. *restart* |
| `compiler.contextHover` | bool | `true` | Hover on a local in a saved file asks `crystal tool context` for its types. |

## `references`

| Key | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `references.includePossible` | bool | `false` | References also list uses whose receiver type is unknown (same name, identity not confirmed). |

## `budgets`

| Key | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `budgets.references` | float | `5.0` | Seconds a references search may run before it stops with a message (0: no limit). |
| `budgets.rename` | float | `5.0` | Same for rename. |
| `budgets.incomingCalls` | float | `5.0` | Same for incoming calls. |
| `budgets.maxCandidates` | int | `2000` | Most candidate files one search reads; over it the search fails with a message. |

## `cache`

| Key | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cache.enabled` | bool | `true` | Persistent index cache (global stdlib/shard packs, project `.clear-ls/cache/`). `--no-cache` turns it off. *restart* |
| `cache.dir` | string | — | Global cache directory (default `$CLEAR_LS_CACHE_DIR`, else the platform cache dir + `clear-ls`). *restart* |

## `inlayHints`

| Key | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `inlayHints.enabled` | bool | `true` | All inlay hints. |
| `inlayHints.locals` | bool | `true` | Type after a local's first assignment (`x = foo` → `x : Int32`), unless obvious from the value (a literal, `T.new`). |
| `inlayHints.blockParams` | bool | `true` | Types of block parameters (`each { |x| }` → `x : String`). |
| `inlayHints.returnTypes` | bool | `true` | Inferred return type after the parameter list of defs written without one. |

## `completion`

| Key | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `completion.setterSnippets` | bool | `true` | Completing `name=` after `x.` writes `x.name = ` (the setter as it is called); binary operators write `x + `, index operators `x[]`. False keeps the method names (`x.name=`, `x.+`). |

## `warmup`

| Key | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `warmup.enabled` | bool | `true` | Infer workspace bodies in the background while idle, so the first references search is fast. |

## Neovim

Neovim 0.11+ with the built-in LSP client (`~/.config/nvim/lsp/clear_ls.lua`,
then `vim.lsp.enable("clear_ls")`):

```lua
return {
  cmd = { "clear-ls", "lsp" },          -- add "--log-file", "/tmp/clear-ls.log" to debug
  filetypes = { "crystal" },
  root_markers = { "shard.yml", ".git" },
  init_options = {
    inlayHints = { blockParams = true },
    completion = { blockStyle = "braces" },
  },
  -- settings are sent with workspace/didChangeConfiguration:
  settings = { clearLs = {} },
}
```

Inlay hints are off in Neovim until enabled: `vim.lsp.inlay_hint.enable(true)`.

### Completion without parentheses (blink.cmp)

clear-ls completes method names without `(`, the usual Crystal call style
(`puts "foo"`, `item.name`). blink.cmp adds `()` to every method item
unless the filetype is blocked (it blocks `ruby` by default, not
`crystal`). Block it:

```lua
require("blink.cmp").setup({
  completion = {
    accept = { auto_brackets = { blocked_filetypes = { "crystal" } } },
  },
})
```

This turns off both of blink's bracket checks (by item kind and by
semantic token) for Crystal. Snippets from clear-ls (blocks, setters)
bring their own brackets and are not affected. nvim-cmp adds no
brackets unless `nvim-autopairs`' cmp integration is set up; exclude
Crystal there: `cmp_autopairs.on_confirm_done({ filetypes = { crystal = false } })`.
